s0301.literal: The imperial carriage arrived at Dadu.
s0301.idiomatic: The imperial carriage arrived at Dadu.

s0302.literal: On guiwei day an edict ordered that whenever the Privy Council mobilized three hundred or more troops, it must be reported to the throne.
s0302.idiomatic: On guiwei day an edict ordered that whenever the Privy Council mobilized 300 or more troops, it must be reported to the throne.

s0303.literal: An edict was issued to instruct Dalicheli and Xiaocheli in Yunnan.
s0303.idiomatic: An edict was issued to instruct Dalicheli and Xiaocheli in Yunnan.

s0304.literal: In Chenji County, Qin Prefecture, heavy rain caused a mountain collapse; overflowing water piled earth at Laigu River into mounds.
s0304.idiomatic: In Chenji County, Qin Prefecture, heavy rain caused a mountain collapse; overflowing water piled earth at Laigu River into mounds.

s0305.literal: Dependent counties of Bianliang and Jinan suffered crop damage from rain; relief was granted.
s0305.idiomatic: Dependent counties of Bianliang and Jinan suffered crop damage from rain; relief was granted.

s0306.literal: Twelve prefectures including Yan'an, Jining, Hangzhou, and Tanzhou, and the departments of Princes Qabar and others suffered famine; relief grain was granted in varying amounts.
s0306.idiomatic: 12 prefectures including Yan'an, Jining, Hangzhou, and Tanzhou, and the departments of Princes Qabar and others suffered famine; relief grain was granted in varying amounts.

s0307.literal: Ninth month, on yiyou day, Yesun Buqa was enfeoffed Prince of Jing and granted a gold seal.
s0307.idiomatic: Ninth month, on yiyou day, Yesun Buqa was enfeoffed Prince of Jing and granted a gold seal.

s0308.literal: Xuande Prefecture was again placed under the Shangdu Resident Commission.
s0308.idiomatic: Xuande Prefecture was again placed under the Shangdu Resident Commission.

s0309.literal: On xinmao day the Haside Jielusi Banbu chief command was abolished and Lintao Chief Command was established in its place.
s0309.idiomatic: On xinmao day the Haside Jielusi Banbu chief command was abolished and Lintao Chief Command was established in its place.

s0310.literal: Guards of the latent residence were granted ten thousand ingots of notes.
s0310.idiomatic: Guards of the latent residence were granted 10,000 ingots of notes.

s0311.literal: On bingshen day the Spirit Hall of Emperor Taizu was repaired.
s0311.idiomatic: On bingshen day the Spirit Hall of Emperor Taizu was repaired.

s0312.literal: On yisi day, on the memorial day of Empress Zhaoxian Yuansheng, Buddhist rites were performed and ten thousand monks were fed; an edict ordered one year's care and relief for the Wuwei Guard Army.
s0312.idiomatic: On yisi day, on the memorial day of Empress Zhaoxian Yuansheng, Buddhist rites were performed and 10,000 monks were fed; an edict ordered 1 year's care and relief for the Wuwei Guard Army.

s0313.literal: On guichou day household property registered and confiscated from Asan's family was given to his son Tuolie.
s0313.idiomatic: On guichou day household property registered and confiscated from Asan's family was given to his son Tuolie.

s0314.literal: Yong Prefecture was redesignated Nanning Route.
s0314.idiomatic: Yong Prefecture was redesignated Nanning Route.

s0315.literal: Cen Shixing sent his younger brother Xingyuan to court with tribute.
s0315.idiomatic: Cen Shixing sent his younger brother Xingyuan to court with tribute.

s0316.literal: Chang'an County of Fengyuan Route suffered heavy rain and the Feng River overflowed; the Luo River in Yan'an Route overflowed; Guantao County of Pu Prefecture and various garrison-farm units suffered flooding; Jianchang and Shaoxing routes suffered famine; relief grain was granted in varying amounts.
s0316.idiomatic: Chang'an County of Fengyuan Route suffered heavy rain and the Feng River overflowed; the Luo River in Yan'an Route overflowed; Guantao County of Pu Prefecture and various garrison-farm units suffered flooding; Jianchang and Shaoxing routes suffered famine; relief grain was granted in varying amounts.

s0317.literal: Tenth month of winter, on yimao day, a Zhao woman in Chenji County, Qin Prefecture, gave birth to three sons at one delivery.
s0317.idiomatic: Tenth month of winter, on yimao day, a Zhao woman in Chenji County, Qin Prefecture, gave birth to 3 sons at one delivery.

s0318.literal: At Chengdu a fine grain stalk produced nine ears from one stem.
s0318.idiomatic: At Chengdu a fine grain stalk produced 9 ears from one stem.

s0319.literal: On dingsi day Supervising Censor Wang Shiyuan requested early instruction of the Crown Prince; the Emperor commended and approved it.
s0319.idiomatic: On dingsi day Supervising Censor Wang Shiyuan requested early instruction of the Crown Prince; the Emperor commended and approved it.

s0320.literal: On wuwu day sacrifice was performed at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
s0320.idiomatic: On wuwu day sacrifice was performed at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

s0321.literal: The Shoufu Chief Command was established, rank 3a, managing Spirit Halls of successive dynasties for sacrifice and revenue matters; the Datianyuan Yansheng Temple Chief Command was demoted to a supervision office subordinate to it.
s0321.idiomatic: The Shoufu Chief Command was established, rank 3a, managing Spirit Halls of successive dynasties for sacrifice and revenue matters; the Datianyuan Yansheng Temple Chief Command was demoted to a supervision office subordinate to it.

s0322.literal: On gengshen day the left and right chancellors were ordered to stand daily duty in the palace; when there were affairs they would proceed to the Central Secretariat.
s0322.idiomatic: On gengshen day the left and right chancellors were ordered to stand daily duty in the palace; when there were affairs they would proceed to the Central Secretariat.

s0323.literal: On bingyin day Venus encroached upon Dipper.
s0323.idiomatic: On bingyin day Venus encroached upon Dipper.

s0324.literal: On jisi day Venus entered Dipper; the moon encroached upon Saturn.
s0324.idiomatic: On jisi day Venus entered Dipper; the moon encroached upon Saturn.

s0325.literal: Cheli barbarians of Yunnan raided; Erdeni was dispatched with an imperial edict to summon and instruct them.
s0325.idiomatic: Cheli barbarians of Yunnan raided; Erdeni was dispatched with an imperial edict to summon and instruct them.

s0326.literal: Their chiefs Saize Zi Nier Yan and Goumu Zi Diaoling came out and submitted.
s0326.idiomatic: Their chiefs Saize Zi Nier Yan and Goumu Zi Diaoling came out and submitted.

s0327.literal: On gengwu day Venus encroached upon Dipper.
s0327.idiomatic: On gengwu day Venus encroached upon Dipper.

s0328.literal: On renshen day Chen Rikuang, heir of Annam, sent his officials Mo Jiefu and others to court with tribute.
s0328.idiomatic: On renshen day Chen Rikuang, heir of Annam, sent his officials Mo Jiefu and others to court with tribute.

s0329.literal: At Zhen Prefecture the Zhujinsha River, and various rivers of Songjiang Prefecture and Wujiang Prefecture were silted; an edict ordered local officials to hire corvée laborers to dredge them.
s0329.idiomatic: At Zhen Prefecture the Zhujinsha River, and various rivers of Songjiang Prefecture and Wujiang Prefecture were silted; an edict ordered local officials to hire corvée laborers to dredge them.

s0330.literal: On bingzi day the Imperial Preceptor was ordered to perform Buddhist rites at Yanchun Pavilion.
s0330.idiomatic: On bingzi day the Imperial Preceptor was ordered to perform Buddhist rites at Yanchun Pavilion.

s0331.literal: On dingchou day princes of Burma including Wuzhena disputed succession; annual tribute was not delivered; the Yunnan Branch Secretariat was ordered to instruct them.
s0331.idiomatic: On dingchou day princes of Burma including Wuzhena disputed succession; annual tribute was not delivered; the Yunnan Branch Secretariat was ordered to instruct them.

s0332.literal: Prince Wang Chan of Yunnan was transferred and enfeoffed Prince of Liang, fief of sixty-five thousand households in Yiyang Prefecture; his son Temür Buqa was enfeoffed to succeed as Prince of Yunnan.
s0332.idiomatic: Prince Wang Chan of Yunnan was transferred and enfeoffed Prince of Liang, fief of 65,000 households in Yiyang Prefecture; his son Temür Buqa was enfeoffed to succeed as Prince of Yunnan.

s0333.literal: Imperial Prince Tugh Temür was enfeoffed Prince of Huai, fief of sixty-five thousand households in Rui Prefecture; annual gifts of silk and cloth were increased by one thousand bolts, and a gold seal was granted.
s0333.idiomatic: Imperial Prince Tugh Temür was enfeoffed Prince of Huai, fief of 65,000 households in Rui Prefecture; annual gifts of silk and cloth were increased by 1,000 bolts, and a gold seal was granted.

s0334.literal: On renwu day Mars encroached upon Rampart Wall Formation.
s0334.idiomatic: On renwu day Mars encroached upon Rampart Wall Formation.

s0335.literal: Yao chiefs Huang Baocai and others of Zhaoqing submitted.
s0335.idiomatic: Yao chiefs Huang Baocai and others of Zhaoqing submitted.

s0336.literal: Yan'an Route suffered famine; charity granary grain was issued for relief, and four thousand ingots of notes were also granted.
s0336.idiomatic: Yan'an Route suffered famine; charity granary grain was issued for relief, and 4,000 ingots of notes were also granted.

s0337.literal: Guangdong Circuit and Jiangxia County of Wuchang Route suffered famine; relief grain was sold at reduced prices in varying amounts.
s0337.idiomatic: Guangdong Circuit and Jiangxia County of Wuchang Route suffered famine; relief grain was sold at reduced prices in varying amounts.

s0338.literal: Henan surveillance commissioner Mainu was dismissed from office for excessively levying public-field rents.
s0338.idiomatic: Henan surveillance commissioner Mainu was dismissed from office for excessively levying public-field rents.

s0339.literal: The daughter of the Grand Princess of Lu State was given in marriage to the Prince of Huai.
s0339.idiomatic: The daughter of the Grand Princess of Lu State was given in marriage to the Prince of Huai.

s0340.literal: Eleventh month, on jichou day, Daoists were ordered to perform libation rites.
s0340.idiomatic: Eleventh month, on jichou day, Daoists were ordered to perform libation rites.

s0341.literal: On guisi day Vice Director Song Ben of the Ministry of War, Vice Directors Zheng Li and Aruhui of the Ministry of Personnel, Chief Clerk Zhang Cheng of the Ministry of Works, and Director Fei Zhu of the Astrological Academy were dispatched to conduct selections separately in Minhai, the Two Guangs, Sichuan, and Yunnan.
s0341.idiomatic: On guisi day Vice Director Song Ben of the Ministry of War, Vice Directors Zheng Li and Aruhui of the Ministry of Personnel, Chief Clerk Zhang Cheng of the Ministry of Works, and Director Fei Zhu of the Astrological Academy were dispatched to conduct selections separately in Minhai, the Two Guangs, Sichuan, and Yunnan.

s0342.literal: Prince Busain said his minister Chuban had merit and requested he be given office; Chuban was appointed Commissioner with Protocol Equal to the Three Excellencies and Duke of Yiguo, granted a silver seal and gold tally.
s0342.idiomatic: Prince Busain said his minister Chuban had merit and requested he be given office; Chuban was appointed Commissioner with Protocol Equal to the Three Excellencies and Duke of Yiguo, granted a silver seal and gold tally.

s0343.literal: Princes Santi Tai and Yesusur were each granted one thousand five hundred ingots of notes, Erdeni Khan one thousand two hundred ingots, and Prince Lubin one thousand five hundred ingots.
s0343.idiomatic: Princes Santi Tai and Yesusur were each granted 1,500 ingots of notes, Erdeni Khan 1,200 ingots, and Prince Lubin 1,500 ingots.

s0344.literal: On jiawu day sacrifice to the stars was performed at the Huihui Bureau of Astronomy.
s0344.idiomatic: On jiawu day sacrifice to the stars was performed at the Huihui Bureau of Astronomy.

s0345.literal: On jihai day Shuwentai was made privy council administrator.
s0345.idiomatic: On jihai day Shuwentai was made privy council administrator.

s0346.literal: On xinchou day a golden treasure canopy was made, adorned with the seven treasures, to store Buddha relics.
s0346.idiomatic: On xinchou day a golden treasure canopy was made, adorned with the 7 treasures, to store Buddha relics.

s0347.literal: On jiachen day a mountain-rest pavilion with deer-peak roof was built at Shangdu.
s0347.idiomatic: On jiachen day a mountain-rest pavilion with deer-peak roof was built at Shangdu.

s0348.literal: On dingwei day prisoners subject to flogging of forty-seven strokes or less and exiles for minor crimes were released; two thousand ingots of notes were distributed to the poor.
s0348.idiomatic: On dingwei day prisoners subject to flogging of 47 strokes or less and exiles for minor crimes were released; 2,000 ingots of notes were distributed to the poor.

s0349.literal: Next year's note printing was ordered: four hundred thousand ingots of Zhiyuan notes and one hundred thousand ingots of Zhongtong notes.
s0349.idiomatic: Next year's note printing was ordered: 400,000 ingots of Zhiyuan notes and 100,000 ingots of Zhongtong notes.

s0350.literal: On jiyou day an edict remitted corvée labor for Nestorian Christians and Dashman.
s0350.idiomatic: On jiyou day an edict remitted corvée labor for Nestorian Christians and Dashman.

s0351.literal: On gengxu day one hundred seventy-five Yao groups including Banling, Great and Little Mulong of Rong Prefecture were summoned and instructed.
s0351.idiomatic: On gengxu day 175 Yao groups including Banling, Great and Little Mulong of Rong Prefecture were summoned and instructed.

s0352.literal: Hejian Route suffered famine; two months' relief grain was granted.
s0352.idiomatic: Hejian Route suffered famine; 2 months' relief grain was granted.

s0353.literal: Bianliang, Xin Prefecture, Quanzhou, Nan'an, Ganzhou, and other routes suffered famine; relief grain was sold at reduced prices in varying amounts.
s0353.idiomatic: Bianliang, Xin Prefecture, Quanzhou, Nan'an, Ganzhou, and other routes suffered famine; relief grain was sold at reduced prices in varying amounts.

s0354.literal: Longxing County of Jiading Route suffered famine; one month's relief grain was granted.
s0354.idiomatic: Longxing County of Jiading Route suffered famine; 1 month's relief grain was granted.

s0355.literal: Thirteen postal stations of Dadu, Shangdu, Xinghe, and other routes suffered famine; eight thousand five hundred ingots of notes were granted in relief.
s0355.idiomatic: 13 postal stations of Dadu, Shangdu, Xinghe, and other routes suffered famine; 8,500 ingots of notes were granted in relief.

s0356.literal: Twelfth month, on guichou new moon, Cen Shixing was appointed General of Huaiyuan, remotely commissioned Pacification Commissioner of Stream-Dong Military and Civilians Along the Frontier, bearing a tiger tally, continuing as chief of Laian Route;
s0356.idiomatic: Twelfth month, on guichou new moon, Cen Shixing was appointed General of Huaiyuan, remotely commissioned Pacification Commissioner of Stream-Dong Military and Civilians Along the Frontier, bearing a tiger tally, continuing as chief of Laian Route;

s0357.literal: Huang Shengxu was appointed General of Huaiyuan, remotely commissioned Pacification Commissioner of Stream-Dong Military and Civilians Along the Frontier, bearing a tiger tally, retiring from office; his son Zhishu succeeded as prefect of Shangsi Prefecture.
s0357.idiomatic: Huang Shengxu was appointed General of Huaiyuan, remotely commissioned Pacification Commissioner of Stream-Dong Military and Civilians Along the Frontier, bearing a tiger tally, retiring from office; his son Zhishu succeeded as prefect of Shangsi Prefecture.

s0358.literal: Imperial edicts were issued to proclaim and instruct; each was also granted two bolts of silk and cloth.
s0358.idiomatic: Imperial edicts were issued to proclaim and instruct; each was also granted 2 bolts of silk and cloth.

s0359.literal: On yimao day Yao of Yunnan, Awu and Wainao, raided; the branch secretariat supervised troops to capture them.
s0359.idiomatic: On yimao day Yao of Yunnan, Awu and Wainao, raided; the branch secretariat supervised troops to capture them.

s0360.literal: On gengshen day Tong Prefecture suffered an earthquake, with a sound like thunder.
s0360.idiomatic: On gengshen day Tong Prefecture suffered an earthquake, with a sound like thunder.

s0361.literal: On guihai day seawater overflowed at Yanguan Prefecture, repeatedly damaging dikes and encroaching on the city walls; envoys were dispatched to sacrifice to the Sea God; officials were also sent to survey favorable terrain, then memorialized requesting stacked-stone embankments; an edict stated: "Building embankments would heavily burden Our people; instead increase stone cribs for defense — perhaps Heaven will aid Us.
s0361.idiomatic: On guihai day seawater overflowed at Yanguan Prefecture, repeatedly damaging dikes and encroaching on the city walls; envoys were dispatched to sacrifice to the Sea God; officials were also sent to survey favorable terrain, then memorialized requesting stacked-stone embankments; an edict stated, "Building embankments would heavily burden Our people; instead increase stone cribs for defense — perhaps Heaven will aid Us.

s0362.literal: " On yichou day Mongol children were granted livestock for breeding.
s0362.idiomatic: On yichou day Mongol children were granted livestock for breeding.

s0363.literal: On bingyin day the Hanlin National History Office was ordered to compile the Veritable Records of Emperors Yingzong and Xianzong.
s0363.idiomatic: On bingyin day the Hanlin National History Office was ordered to compile the Veritable Records of Emperors Yingzong and Xianzong.

s0364.literal: An edict stated: "For all inner and outer officials performing court congratulations and similar rites, in rain or snow mourning dress is exempted.
s0364.idiomatic: An edict stated, "For all inner and outer officials performing court congratulations and similar rites, in rain or snow mourning dress is exempted.

s0365.literal: " On gengwu day Mars encroached upon Outer Screen.
s0365.idiomatic: On gengwu day Mars encroached upon Outer Screen.

s0366.literal: On xinwei day the newly built Palm Hall was completed.
s0366.idiomatic: On xinwei day the newly built Palm Hall was completed.

s0367.literal: Prince Suoside died; five hundred ingots of notes were granted as funeral gifts.
s0367.idiomatic: Prince Suoside died; 500 ingots of notes were granted as funeral gifts.

s0368.literal: On yihai day Venus crossed the sky.
s0368.idiomatic: On yihai day Venus crossed the sky.

s0369.literal: A partial amnesty was granted to thirty-eight prisoners facing serious punishment, to seek blessings for the Three Palaces.
s0369.idiomatic: A partial amnesty was granted to 38 prisoners facing serious punishment, to seek blessings for the Three Palaces.

s0370.literal: Nine dong including Rongmi Cave barbarians led by Tian Xianshiyong of Kuizhou Route raided; the Sichuan Branch Secretariat dispatched envoys to instruct five dongs to submit; the rest were pursued with troops.
s0370.idiomatic: 9 dong including Rongmi Cave barbarians led by Tian Xianshiyong of Kuizhou Route raided; the Sichuan Branch Secretariat dispatched envoys to instruct 5 dongs to submit; the rest were pursued with troops.

s0371.literal: The Shaanxi Branch Secretariat sent troops to suppress Tibetan tribes of Jie Prefecture.
s0371.idiomatic: The Shaanxi Branch Secretariat sent troops to suppress Tibetan tribes of Jie Prefecture.

s0372.literal: The Chaghan Na'ur wanhu department suffered famine; one month's relief grain was granted.
s0372.idiomatic: The Chaghan Na'ur wanhu department suffered famine; 1 month's relief grain was granted.

s0373.literal: Yan'an Route suffered hail damage; one month's relief grain was granted.
s0373.idiomatic: Yan'an Route suffered hail damage; 1 month's relief grain was granted.

s0374.literal: At Yueqing County salt fields of Wenzhou Route flooding occurred; the people suffered famine; charity granary grain was issued for relief.
s0374.idiomatic: At Yueqing County salt fields of Wenzhou Route flooding occurred; the people suffered famine; charity granary grain was issued for relief.

s0375.literal: Zhejiang East and various prefectures of Jiangdong suffered flood and drought; sixty-four thousand three hundred and odd qing of fields were damaged.
s0375.idiomatic: Zhejiang East and various prefectures of Jiangdong suffered flood and drought; 64,300 and odd qing of fields were damaged.

s0376.literal: Second year, spring, first month, on bingxu day Mercury encroached upon Celestial Cock.
s0376.idiomatic: Second year, spring, first month, on bingxu day Mercury encroached upon Celestial Cock.

s0377.literal: On yiwei day, because the capital region had poor harvests, the spring hunt was cancelled.
s0377.idiomatic: On yiwei day, because the capital region had poor harvests, the spring hunt was cancelled.

s0378.literal: Consorts, imperial princes, and imperial sons-in-law were forbidden to associate with masters of star-divination; those not officials of the Directorate of Astronomy must not rashly speak of fortune and calamity.
s0378.idiomatic: Consorts, imperial princes, and imperial sons-in-law were forbidden to associate with masters of star-divination; those not officials of the Directorate of Astronomy must not rashly speak of fortune and calamity.

s0379.literal: An edict stated: "Censorate selections shall be jointly deliberated with the Central Secretariat and reported.
s0379.idiomatic: An edict stated, "Censorate selections shall be jointly deliberated with the Central Secretariat and reported.

s0380.literal: " Central Secretariat officials stated: "In Jiangnan the people are poor and monks rich; temple and monastery lands not originally established in Song times nor granted by successive dynasties — it is requested they be subjected to corvée equally with the people according to the old system.
s0380.idiomatic: Central Secretariat officials stated, "In Jiangnan the people are poor and monks rich; temple and monastery lands not originally established in Song times nor granted by successive dynasties — it is requested they be subjected to corvée equally with the people according to the old system.

s0381.literal: " Approved; registered Basijisi land was granted to the wives and children of the late Supervising Censor Guanyinbao and Suo'ao'er Hademishi, ten qing each.
s0381.idiomatic: Approved; registered Basijisi land was granted to the wives and children of the late Supervising Censor Guanyinbao and Suo'ao'er Hademishi, 10 qing each.

s0382.literal: On wuxu day an elephant carriage was made.
s0382.idiomatic: On wuxu day an elephant carriage was made.

s0383.literal: Canbulang submitted; its chief Banshu'er was granted silver, notes, silk, and cloth.
s0383.idiomatic: Canbulang submitted; its chief Banshu'er was granted silver, notes, silk, and cloth.

s0384.literal: On xinchou day Prince of Huai Tugh Temür went out to reside at Jiankang.
s0384.idiomatic: On xinchou day Prince of Huai Tugh Temür went out to reside at Jiankang.

s0385.literal: On renyin day Venus encroached upon Establishment Star.
s0385.idiomatic: On renyin day Venus encroached upon Establishment Star.

s0386.literal: On jiachen day the image of Emperor Xianzong was installed at Yongfu Temple; one hundred qing of sacrificial fields were granted.
s0386.idiomatic: On jiachen day the image of Emperor Xianzong was installed at Yongfu Temple; 100 qing of sacrificial fields were granted.

s0387.literal: Mountain Liao of Guangxi raided; local officials were ordered to capture them.
s0387.idiomatic: Mountain Liao of Guangxi raided; local officials were ordered to capture them.

s0388.literal: Jiang-Zhe Branch Secretariat Grand Councillor Tuohuandala Khan was promoted to left chancellor.
s0388.idiomatic: Jiang-Zhe Branch Secretariat Grand Councillor Tuohuandala Khan was promoted to left chancellor.

s0389.literal: Prince Qiebie sent envoys presenting local products; forty thousand ingots of notes were granted.
s0389.idiomatic: Prince Qiebie sent envoys presenting local products; 40,000 ingots of notes were granted.

s0390.literal: On wushen day Qilasi Siba Banzangbu was made Pacification Commissioner-General of the Tibetan Routes and others, concurrently managing darugachi overseeing troops of Changhexi, Benbu'er Yisigang, Chashajia'er, Duogansi, Duosima, and others, and went with his subordinates to pacify Canbulang.
s0390.idiomatic: On wushen day Qilasi Siba Banzangbu was made Pacification Commissioner-General of the Tibetan Routes and others, concurrently managing darugachi overseeing troops of Changhexi, Benbu'er Yisigang, Chashajia'er, Duogansi, Duosima, and others, and went with his subordinates to pacify Canbulang.

s0391.literal: On gengxu day an edict instructed the chief ministers: "Recently Jo'erhan Chakulu and the lands beyond the mountains all suffered earthquakes; throughout the inner prefectures the great and small people face famine.
s0391.idiomatic: On gengxu day an edict instructed the chief ministers, "Recently Jo'erhan Chakulu and the lands beyond the mountains all suffered earthquakes; throughout the inner prefectures the great and small people face famine.

s0392.literal: Since Our accession We have ever recalled the hardships of Taizu's founding and the greatness of Shizu's unification, hoping to share peace and joy with the people; We constantly hold reverent fear — yet calamities arrive whose causes cannot be fathomed.
s0392.idiomatic: Since Our accession We have ever recalled the hardships of Taizu's founding and the greatness of Shizu's unification, hoping to share peace and joy with the people; We constantly hold reverent fear — yet calamities arrive whose causes cannot be fathomed.

s0393.literal: Could it be that Our deliberations have fallen short and affairs have exceeded their proper measure, so Heaven therefore shows this warning?
s0393.idiomatic: Could it be that Our deliberations have fallen short and affairs have exceeded their proper measure, so Heaven therefore shows this warning?

s0394.literal: You and others should jointly deliberate with the various offices on measures benefiting the people; consider starting from capital offenses; when deliberation is settled report it.
s0394.idiomatic: You and others should jointly deliberate with the various offices on measures benefiting the people; consider starting from capital offenses; when deliberation is settled report it.

s0395.literal: We shall proclaim a general amnesty to announce throughout the realm.
s0395.idiomatic: We shall proclaim a general amnesty to announce throughout the realm.

s0396.literal: " Zhaoqing, Gongchang, Yan'an, Ganzhou, Nan'an, Yingde, Xin Prefecture, Meizhou, and other places suffered famine; relief grain was sold at reduced prices in varying amounts.
s0396.idiomatic: Zhaoqing, Gongchang, Yan'an, Ganzhou, Nan'an, Yingde, Xin Prefecture, Meizhou, and other places suffered famine; relief grain was sold at reduced prices in varying amounts.

s0397.literal: Intercalary month, on renzi new moon, an edict granted amnesty throughout the realm, abolished the Jiang-Huai newly imposed wrapped-silver levy, and remitted corvée taxes for one year in disaster-stricken areas.
s0397.idiomatic: Intercalary month, on renzi new moon, an edict granted amnesty throughout the realm, abolished the Jiang-Huai newly imposed wrapped-silver levy, and remitted corvée taxes for 1 year in disaster-stricken areas.

s0398.literal: On gengshen day the roads of Yehu Pass, Seze, and Sanggan Ridge were repaired.
s0398.idiomatic: On gengshen day the roads of Yehu Pass, Seze, and Sanggan Ridge were repaired.

s0399.literal: On yichou day an order was issued to rectify garrison farms.
s0399.idiomatic: On yichou day an order was issued to rectify garrison farms.

s0400.literal: Yao Wei, left associate of the Henan Branch Secretariat, requested prohibiting garrison-farm officials from encroaching on garrison households and avoiding pursuit of surplus increases that would abandon the intent of enriching the people; no reply was given.
s0400.idiomatic: Yao Wei, left associate of the Henan Branch Secretariat, requested prohibiting garrison-farm officials from encroaching on garrison households and avoiding pursuit of surplus increases that would abandon the intent of enriching the people; no reply was given.
